title: Google AI tools launch drives automation and design surge #shorts #google #ai
description: Google has released 15 free AI tools that significantly streamline digital content creation and development. Key offerings include Pomeli, which automatically generates social media content from website links; Stitch, a tool for creating modern UI designs from text prompts; Google Opal, an AI-powered automation workflow builder comparable to N8N or Make; Antigravity, an AI code editor designed for efficient coding; and Mixport, a creative platform combining AI image generation with customizable mixing features. These tools harness Google’s advanced AI models to replace costly subscriptions and simplify processes in marketing, design, automation, coding, and visual content generation. The suite reflects a broader trend of AI integration aimed at accelerating productivity and reducing dependency on multiple specialized software, offering substantial value to developers, content creators, and businesses. #GoogleAItools #Pomeli #StitchUI #GoogleOpal #AntigravityEditor #MixportAI #AIAutomation #AIContentCreation #UIDesignAI #AICodeEditor #AIimageGeneration #ProductivityTools #AIworkflow #TechInnovation #DigitalCreation
